sentences.text: Mijanur Mallick & Ors vs Unknown on 21 March, 2023

Author: Bibek Chaudhuri
Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
21.03.2023

In the matter of : Mijanur Mallick &
Ors.
Ms. Sonali Das ...for the petitioner.
Mr. Rudradipto Nandy, Ms. Manisha Sharma ...for the State.
Mr. Dhananjoy Banerjee, Sk. Sahil Ahad ...for the opposite party no. 2.

A matrimonial dispute between the parties culminated in registration of Chandrakona Police Station Case No. 193/2019 dated 22nd June, 2019 under Sections 498A/323/307/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

The investigation of the said case is complete and charge-sheet has been filed against the accused persons under Sections 498A/323/307/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with the penal provisions under the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The petitioners have prayed for quashing of the said criminal proceeding on the ground that the dispute has been amicably settled between the parties.
Copy of joint petition of compromise has been served to the learned Advocate for the State.

Learned Public Prosecutor-in-Charge is directed to submit a report of the Officer-in-Charge of Chandrakona Police Station/Investing Officer of this case within 10 days from this date after ascertaining the fact as to whether the settlement has been arrived at without any threat, coercion or undue influence.
On receipt of such report, further order shall be passed.
In the meantime, the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ghatal, Paschim Medinipur shall not pass any coercive orders against the petitioners.
